announcements.name: Enhanced Copilot Chat in Fabric notebooks
announcements.shortDescription: An upgraded conversational experience that helps users work directly in the Fabric portal.
announcements.longDescription: The newly enhanced Copilot Chat in Fabric notebooks helps users work directly in the Fabric web portal. It is presented as one of the conversational AI experiences suited for exploration, debugging, and ad hoc analysis, keeping the engineer close to the data while guiding the AI step by step.

announcements.name: Fabric Data Engineering extension for VS Code with MCP support
announcements.shortDescription: Now enhanced with the Fabric notebook MCP server and tools that make the GitHub Copilot agent aware of Fabric context, including lakehouse targets.
announcements.longDescription: The Fabric Data Engineering extension in VS Code is now enhanced with MCP and tools that make the custom GitHub Copilot agent aware of Fabric context. It targets professional developers and data engineers who are most productive in an IDE with GitHub Copilot and source control. In the demo it is used with a Fabric-aware notebook agent mode to read an event stream from a Spark notebook leveraging Kafka, bridging Spark and real-time intelligence (RTI) in Fabric.

announcements.name: Fabric-aware notebook agent mode
announcements.shortDescription: Lets Copilot read a Spark notebook, discover skills in built-in folders (E2E medallion architecture, eventhouse authoring), propose a phased plan, and execute selected cells.
announcements.longDescription: The Fabric-aware notebook agent mode, available through the new Fabric Data Engineering VS Code extension, lets Copilot read a Spark notebook reading from an event stream and propose an ingestion plan. Copilot interprets the notebook, scans built-in folders, and discovers available skills such as E2E medallion architecture and eventhouse authoring best practices. It then suggests a phased plan starting with a Phase 1 Bronze Layer that parses the JSON value column, adds tracking/metadata columns (ingestion timestamp and batch ID), writes to a Delta bronze table in append-only mode with checkpointing, and validates row counts.
